pr_body:
Change to use the CLDR locale provider on JDK23+, rather than COMPAT

Also change several tests and doc examples that use the root locale to instead use english, as it is expecting the day-of-week names in english. Tests that use german I've changed to french, as that isn't changed between COMPAT and CLDR.

This fixes #109003, fixes #108855, fixes #108857, fixes #109188, fixes #109189, fixes #109200, fixes #108625
